parsed.notes: Reviewed all five assertion_id rows under Lens B only. No support or quote-fidelity defects were raised.

reasons: The lake identity record is verified and matches Pennsylvania v. Labron, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 1996-07-01.
The lake citations include official citation 518 U.S. 938, parallel citations 116 S. Ct. 2485 and 135 L. Ed. 2d 1031, and vendor-neutral citation 1996 U.S. LEXIS 4268.
The lake treatment field remains good_law as of 2026-06-30, and no disclosed edge identifies Labron itself as overruled, abrogated, superseded, or limited.
residual_risks: Treatment derivation notes audit_needed and cap_hit in negative/top-cited lanes, so undisclosed future audit could alter the treatment call, but the disclosed judgment field is good_law.

residual_risks: Support accuracy and quotation completeness are reserved for Lens A.

reasons: Lens B does not review whether the home-role label is substantively optimal.

residual_risks: Whether 'Key — Progeny / Refinement' is the best support taxonomy is outside this lens.

reasons: The content treatment fields match the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity good_law, as_of_content 1996-07-01, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, composite_basis migration-seed, varies_by_point false, and no point_overrides.

The disclosed treatment edges list citing cases with negative-looking field_ii labels, but each edge's field_iii is mentioned and each is proposed true; the disclosed record does not convert those into a negative treatment of Labron.
The lake provenance warns the treatment was migrated, and the page discloses the scope note that S2 derivation may re-derive and downgrade.
residual_risks: The derivation metadata reports audit_needed and cap_hit for lane1_negative and lane2_top_cited, so the good_law status should be treated as dependent on the disclosed lake judgment rather than an independently completed audit.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Surface the migration-seed/audit-needed caveat in the visible Treatment section, not only in frontmatter.

reasons: The lake identity record identifies the court as U.S. Supreme Court and court_level as scotus.
The content label 'Binding — SCOTUS' is consistent with the disclosed court identity.
No disclosed treatment field or progeny edge downgrades the authority weight.
residual_risks: The lake record does not contain a separate authority_weight field, so this is verified by the disclosed court identity rather than an explicit lake weight field.
